name: Approved run → provision the sandbox and prove it cold (before the dev loop)
description:
The provision-and-prove-cold station (design SB2/SB4/SB7). This is the make-or-break both predecessors lacked: neither ever proved a project builds COLD in a fresh environment. On an approved run — after the projection station (dev-from-task/03) has frozen the change's tasks into task.spec — this rule spawns a forced loop that calls provision_sandbox, which materializes the run's checkout, builds the operator-DECLARED image, and proves the repo resolves its base deps and builds cold in a fresh container, then stamps the harness-DERIVED sandbox.ready + attestation (or a sandbox.blocked reason). G2: this rule fires no lifecycle transition; provisioning is a tool measuring and writing evidence facts, and the readiness gate + park are separate rules that READ those facts.

RUN BINDING: run_scope=inherit reads the run entity's bare agent.run triple (stamped by dev-from-task/01-anchor-run-for-dispatch, the same anchor projection and the dev re-wake inherit) and sets the provision loop's RunID to it, so provision_sandbox resolves THIS run's entity from its tool-call metadata and stamps sandbox.* on it. A run entity carries no bare agent.run of its own, so this rule requires agent.run ne "".

ROLE = coordinator (design roster: only Sarah/Amelia/Quinn; Sarah owns the openspec/projection/provisioning tools). There is no separate provisioner persona — this is a coordinator loop scoped to a tool, exactly like the create_change/validate_change/project_tasks authoring loops. tool_choice=function forces provision_sandbox and tools stays nil (global discovery advertises it); the loop calls it and terminates (StopLoop), writing sandbox.* (not coordinator.decision.*), so it triggers no coordinator decision rule. provision_sandbox takes NO arguments (G3) — the model may only TRIGGER the proof, never supply the environment or the outcome (readiness is proven cold, not claimed).

ORDERING (after projection, before the dev re-wake): gated on task.spec.0.test_command ne "" (projection complete), so provisioning runs AFTER dev-from-task/03 and its forced provision_sandbox turn does not race the projection turn on the journey's positional cursor. The dev re-wake (dev-from-task/02) is in turn gated on sandbox.ready eq true, so it fires only AFTER this station proves the sandbox — giving the deterministic order project_tasks → provision_sandbox → decide(dev_from_task). Provisioning is sequenced after projection (rather than in parallel) purely to serialize the forced-tool turns; a run whose tasks never project has nothing to develop, so not provisioning it is correct.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps the fired-once marker sandbox.provisioned=$entity.instance on the run, and the sandbox.provisioned length_eq 0 guard makes the trigger flip false the moment it fires. This is the house restart-safety pattern (semteams agent-run/02, dev-from-task/02 and /03): publish_agent is NOT idempotent (each fire mints a fresh loop; the framework does not dedup), and the other trigger conditions (agent.run/executing/approved/projected) stay true, so WITHOUT this marker a graph replay with RULE_STATE lost (while ENTITY_STATES survives — asymmetric bucket loss) would re-spawn a DUPLICATE provision loop. The marker (a durable ENTITY_STATES triple) closes that independent of RULE_STATE. Marker stamped BEFORE the publish so a publish failure leaves the run stuck-toward-human rather than duplicated; provision_sandbox itself also refuses to re-materialize when sandbox.ready is already present (a second guard, so an idempotent re-invoke never wipes an in-progress apply_patch checkout). RESTART CARRY-FORWARD (M2): the checkout provision materializes is in-memory-mapped (runspace.Checkouts), so a process restart loses the mapping while the marker + sandbox.ready survive; at M0 the e2e is single-process so this is unreachable, and if it did occur the outcome is a fail-closed park (the dev tools' Workspace.Root errors → no false verify), never a silent proceed. The M2 fix is a recoverable, deterministically-keyed checkout dir under a stable base (design group-4/5 carry-forward), NOT a re-fire on the surviving marker.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
SEMDEV — the human approved this run's change and its tasks are projected. Provision the sandbox and prove it cold before development begins.

Call provision_sandbox. The harness materializes the run's checkout, builds the operator-declared image, and proves the repo resolves its dependencies and builds cold in a fresh container — it takes no arguments and you cannot supply the environment or the outcome. Calling provision_sandbox completes your turn.

metadata.station: provision_sandbox — build the declared image + prove the repo builds cold (SB2/SB4)
metadata.trigger_rationale: spec: on an approved run, stand up the sandbox and cold-prove it before the dev loop relies on it. Fires on the RUN entity after approval + projection, requiring the agent.run anchor (dev-from-task/01) so run_scope=inherit binds the provision loop to this run.
metadata.role_rationale: coordinator (Sarah owns the provisioning tool; 3-role roster has no separate provisioner). tool_choice=function:provision_sandbox + nil tools (global discovery) forces the call — a tool turn, not a routing turn. Mirrors dev-from-task/03 project_tasks.
metadata.ordering: gated on task.spec.0.test_command ne "" (projection complete) so it runs AFTER dev-from-task/03 and its forced turn does not race the projection turn; the dev re-wake (dev-from-task/02) is gated on sandbox.ready eq true so it runs AFTER this — deterministic order project_tasks → provision_sandbox → decide(dev_from_task).
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the sandbox.provisioned marker + length_eq 0 guard (house pattern). publish_agent is not idempotent, so the one-shot is intrinsic (not reliant on RULE_STATE); provision_sandbox's own already-ready refusal is a second guard. M2 carry-forward: the in-memory checkout mapping is lost on restart while the marker survives — unreachable at M0 (single-process e2e) and fail-closed-park if it occurred; the fix is a recoverable deterministically-keyed checkout, not a marker re-fire.
metadata.g3: provision_sandbox takes NO arguments — readiness is PROVEN cold (build the declared image, resolve+build the repo in a fresh cache), never model-supplied.
metadata.deferred_rewake_scoping: tools omitted = global discovery; a real model could call a registered tool other than provision_sandbox. Inert under the mock (positional cursor). Closed with the coordinated MEDIUM-3 tool-scoping change before the first real-LLM token.
